freeze.correction: Suppress relative MSE/opponent error when baseline MSE<=1e-12; absolute errors and predictions unchanged.

training_freeze.domain: Signed balanced camera RGB/mosaic, unclipped; packing TL/TR/BL/BR, explicit Bayer tags.
training_freeze.conditioning: Sigma from noisy observation and known simulation coefficients, not clean-target sigma.
training_freeze.selection: One seed, Adam, fixed2048 steps, final checkpoint; no evaluation-dependent tuning.

ambiguity_witness.interpretation: No deterministic single-image reconstruction can recover both targets from this same observation.

limits: Procedural train/evaluation families share construction rules; not natural-scene generalization.
Signal-dependent Gaussian CFA noise is uncalibrated; no Canon noise-profile or ISO claim.
Synthetic RGB is already camera RGB; no physical spectral response, optics, PRNU or real compression model.
Evaluation against own bilinear baseline only, not RCD, Lightroom or another trained network.
An ambiguous same-mosaic pair is a limitation witness, excluded from quality aggregate.
No RAW training, camera-level validation, visual approval, default change or production hook.
Baseline-near-zero ratios are undefined; inspect absolute errors instead.
